title: Verify successful login with standard credentials
preconditions: App is reachable at Sauce Demo login page
steps: Open https://www.saucedemo.com; Enter username standard_user; Enter password secret_sauce; Click Login
expectedResult: Inventory page loads; Products heading is visible; URL reflects inventory route

title: Verify locked user cannot authenticate
preconditions: App is reachable at Sauce Demo login page
steps: Open https://www.saucedemo.com; Enter username locked_out_user; Enter password secret_sauce; Click Login
expectedResult: Error message indicating user is locked out is displayed; User remains on login page

title: Verify inventory sort by Price (Low to High)
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user on inventory page
steps: Open sort dropdown; Select Price (Low to High)
expectedResult: Product prices render in ascending order (first price <= next visible price)

title: Verify add-to-cart updates cart badge
preconditions: Logged in as standard_user on inventory page
steps: Note initial cart badge; Click Add to cart on one product
expectedResult: Cart badge count increases by 1 (or badge appears with 1)

title: Verify remove-from-cart restores inventory state
preconditions: Logged in with one item in cart on inventory page
steps: Open cart sidebar or cart page; Remove the item from cart
expectedResult: Cart badge returns to empty/0; Add to cart is available again for that product

title: Verify checkout completes with valid shopper details
preconditions: Logged in; at least one item in cart
steps: Open cart; Proceed to Checkout; Fill First Name; Fill Last Name; Fill Postal Code; Continue; Finish
expectedResult: Order completes; Thank you confirmation is shown

title: Verify logout ends session
expectedResult: Login page displayed; Subsequent visit to inventory requires login
